title: Ephemeral rate-cap accordion and soft-evictor for regional rampdown and emergency unwind
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce ephemeral tenant-aware transient rate cap (accordion) and a soft-evictor with cooldown windows to smooth regional rampdowns and provide an emergency unwind path. No breaking changes. Recommended rollout: staged canary -> 25% -> 100% with automatic metrics gating.
description: Context: We observed two related problems during the recent surge incidents: (1) sudden per-tenant bursts caused regional controller thrashing and rapid circuit flips, and (2) emergency operator unwind requests could produce hard evictions that caused downstream quality regressions. This PR implements a tenant-aware ephemeral rate-cap "accordion" that dynamically compresses burstable capacity across tenants during regional rampdown, and a "soft-evictor" that performs staged eviction with a cooldown and graceful fallback to cached/low-fidelity responses. Motivation: reduce cascading circuit breaker flips and give operators a low-risk emergency unwind that does not immediately hard-evict in-flight work. Design summary: - Ephemeral rate-cap accordion: transient token buckets per-tenant that can be compressed by the regional sequencer when a region is ramping down (capacity contraction). Compression is proportional to tenant priority and recent SLO history. - Soft-evictor: instead of immediately marking requests as evicted, we mark them as candidate-evicted and begin a short TTL-based drain (default 3s) during which requests may be retried, redirected to a read-only KV cache, or compacted to a lower-cost model. After the TTL, candidates are converted to evicted. - Emergency unwind endpoint: operator API to request an unwind for a region with a staged mode (observe -> soft-unwind -> hard-unwind). This gives time to ramp evictions and observe impacts. - SLO enforcement hooks: the accordion consults SLO credit windows and can preferentially preserve capacity for tenants below error budget thresholds. - Observability: new metrics (accordion.compress_ratio, evictor.candidate_count, unwind.stage) and tracing spans for decision points. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of token compression and tenant priority weighting - [x] Soft-evictor state machine and cooldown timer - [x] Emergency unwind operator API and RBAC gating - [x] Unit tests for compression math and state transitions - [x] Integration test in perf-canary with synthetic spike and regional rampdown - [x] Dashboard panels and alerts for regressions Rollout plan: 1) Deploy canary to perf-canary cluster behind feature flag 2) Monitor compress_ratio and candidate_count during synthetic and real traffic 3) Gradually enable in a single region (25%) with automatic rollback on SLO regressions 4) If stable, enable global. Backwards compatibility: operator API is additive; default behavior remains unchanged unless feature flag enabled. Related: ENG-1249 (tenancy SLO policies), SRE-88 (regional rampdown postmortem). Merge notes: squash-merged after CI re-run; no DB migrations or client surface changes.
